queries.query: large language model OR LLM "network configuration" OR "NetOps" "intent-to-configuration" "config synthesis"
queries.rationale: Locate work that uses LLMs to generate network configurations or translate natural-language intent into configs.

queries.query: LLM self-correction OR "generate-validate-repair" "tool-assisted" verifier Batfish "iterative repair" "bounded self-correction"
queries.rationale: Identify mechanisms for LLM-generated-output verification and automated repair in NetOps (generate→validate→repair loops, verifier-assisted correction).

queries.query: safety OR reliability "LLM" "network operations" "AIOps" "agentic" "autonomous agent" "failure modes"
queries.rationale: Survey safety, reliability, and failure-mode analyses of agentic LLM systems applied to operational tasks.

queries.query: benchmark OR evaluation "LLM" networking "AIOps benchmark" "NetOps benchmark" "dataset" "validity"
queries.rationale: Find existing benchmarks/datasets for LLMs in networking/AIOps and critiques of their validity and realism.

queries.query: network configuration verification "formal methods" "model checking" SMT "reachability" Batfish Anteater "policy compliance"
queries.rationale: Gather foundational and recent work on formal/deterministic validators for network configs (useful as gold-standard validators).

queries.query: evaluation metrics "operational correctness" "policy compliance" reachability latency "semantic correctness" "configuration drift" NetOps metrics
queries.rationale: Collect papers defining operationally meaningful metrics for evaluating generated network changes and their safety.
Explore architectures that let LLMs call analyzers, simulators, or validators (tool-assisted NetOps agents).

queries.query: human-in-the-loop LLM NetOps "operator oversight" explainability trust "approval workflow"
queries.rationale: Locate work on human oversight, explainability, and trust models for LLM-driven operational workflows.
Search for threat models and adversarial attacks relevant when LLMs produce or modify operational configs.

queries.query: network emulation OR simulation Mininet NS-3 container lab "config execution" "testbed" reproducibility evaluation
queries.rationale: Identify available emulators/testbeds and best practices to execute and evaluate generated configs reproducibly.

queries.query: AIOps DevOps "infrastructure as code" IaC Terraform Ansible "configuration synthesis" "policy as code"
queries.rationale: Survey neighbouring fields (IaC, DevOps, AIOps) where automated config generation, validation, and deployment are studied.

queries.query: benchmark methodology "statistical validity" "paired design" "confidence intervals" "multiple comparisons" reproducibility "evaluation protocol"
queries.rationale: Collect methodological literature on how to design valid, reproducible benchmark experiments and statistical analyses.

queries.query: public network configuration datasets "RouteViews" "CAIDA" "NetBench" "public configs" "routing datasets"
queries.rationale: Find concrete datasets and measurement collections useful for constructing realistic NetOps tasks and ground truth.

queries.query: prior work "LLM for network" "LLM-driven change plan" "LLM configuration repair" "Batfish+LLM"
queries.rationale: Target nearest existing integrations of language models with network-verification tools or automated change planning to assess novelty gaps.

queries.query: ethics authorship disclosure "AI-generated manuscript" "agentic researcher" "disclosure statement" reproducibility policy
queries.rationale: Collect policy and ethics guidance relevant to autonomous AI authorship, disclosure requirements, and reproducibility norms.

inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed papers, arXiv preprints, or stable dataset/repository releases with clear provenance
Work directly addressing LLM/agent use in network configuration, validation, or NetOps automation
Papers on verification tools, formal methods, and validators applicable to network configs
Benchmarks, datasets, and testbeds that enable realistic NetOps evaluation or replication
Methodology papers on benchmark validity, statistical design, and reproducibility
Human-in-the-loop, safety, security, and ethics studies relevant to operational automation
exclusion_criteria: Works that only assess generic NLP capabilities without operational NetOps relevance
Informal blog posts or opinion pieces lacking verifiable artifacts or citations (unless from major vendors with reproducible docs)
Papers older than foundational relevance where superseded by recent work, unless cited for historical context
Proprietary or non-public datasets/tools that cannot be cited or inspected
date_rationale: Prioritize 2020–2026 literature to capture rapid developments in LLMs and agentic systems, while including earlier foundational work (pre-2020) for network verification, formal methods, and DevOps/IaC background where relevant.
